content.text: Found a bug: empty zones didn't include their origin in the existing-name set. Fixing:

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='/workspace/submission/main.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("    existing = set()\n    for owner in grouped:\n", "    existing = set()\n    existing.add(origin)\n    for owner in grouped:\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
